title: Quick chips, tags and the pin — round 4

steps.path: The pencil at the end of the chips above the message box
steps.headline: Two shelves, chips with a pencil on hover. Where should editing open?
steps.notice: All three share the resting look: "Shown above the message box" and "Set aside" shelves of chips; drag between them to show or hide a chip, along a row to reorder; a pencil appears on the chip you point at (shown on Inbox). Pictures are after clicking Inbox's pencil. "Set aside" is new: chips you keep but don't show.

variants.label: Edit card below
variants.summary: An "Edit “Inbox”" card opens under the shelves: name, message, Save / Cancel / Remove.
variants.risk: The popup grows taller while you edit.

variants.label: Edit page
variants.summary: The popup turns into an "Edit “Inbox”" page with "‹ All chips" to go back, and a "Show above the message box" switch.
variants.risk: The shelves are out of sight while you edit.

variants.label: Small panel by the chip
variants.summary: A small floating panel opens right under the chip you clicked.
variants.risk: It covers the shelf under it while open.

steps.path: The tag chip in the status bar
steps.headline: Which tags layout?
steps.notice: All: Pin to top first, Note last, the approved "…" menu on each tag (shown on work in the cloud).

variants.label: Rows with switches
variants.summary: Last round's: one tag per row, a switch at the right.

variants.label: Tag cloud
variants.summary: All tags as chips in one block: filled when on this session, faint outline when not; click to switch. "…" appears beside a chip on hover.
variants.risk: On and off differ only by how strong the chip looks.

variants.label: On this session / Add a tag
variants.summary: Two cards: the tags on this session (✕ to take one off), then every other tag with + to add and "…" for the menu.
variants.risk: Taller; a tag moves between the two cards when you click it.

steps.path: The session list at the top of the window (first row is pinned)
steps.headline: Where and how should the pin show?
steps.notice: Resume's cards and the status bar's tag chip follow whichever you pick.

variants.label: Before the name
variants.summary: An outline pin just before the session's name.

variants.label: By the status
variants.summary: A filled accent-colour pin just left of the Working/Inactive pill.

variants.label: A "Pinned" pill
variants.summary: A small grey "Pinned" pill with a pin, beside the status pill.
variants.risk: Wider; on a long name the name gets cut sooner.
